_about: Steady-state numbers from runs on 2026-11-03 whose raw stamp files were overwritten. Copied from the per-run summaries printed at the time. Cycles are emulator cycles (emu-quasar-1x3), median of the bank-to-bank times after the first two banks.

copy_fp32_nosync_path_a._source: test_perf_dest_write_path_format_sweep_quasar, Float32 -> Float32, stamp sync off. Drain and SetDatValid gave the same numbers.

copy_fp16in_fp32out_nosync._source: test_perf_dest_write_path_format_sweep_quasar, Float16_b -> Float32, stamp sync off, 4 tiles per bank.

copy_fp32_srcs_opts_b_done._source: test_perf_dest_write_path_srcs_opt_quasar, Float32 -> Float32, B-done, stamp sync off. Cycles per bank at 1 to 4 tiles per bank.

matmul_cycles_per_bank._source: CT x KT order: 1x1, 1x4, 4x1, 4x4. A and B-original from runs 1-3 (HiFi4; LoFi identical). B-both from test_dest_preload_matmul_quasar -k srcs_opt (LoFi, drain and done hand-offs identical). L1-acc from perf_dest_preload_matmul_quasar (LoFi). All with stamp sync on.
